en-US.description: Intuitive ID badge design and printing software for Magicard printers
en-US.longDescription: Magicard TrustID is the intuitive solution for anyone needing to design and print professional, secure ID badges quickly and effortlessly. With its easy drag-and-drop interface, you do not need design or database expertise — just follow 7 simple steps to create the perfect ID card.
en-US.name: TrustID
